You may have this creature enter as a copy of an artifact or creature you control.

semantics: The early owned entry phase chooses a flat copiable recipe before copied tap/counter/choice/Aura initialization; selection is not targeting and excludes simultaneous entrants.
Only cold EntryMove preparation changes before successful commit. A failed/declined entry never installs a copy layer. Physical identity and face structure are retained by existing owned copy rows.
A successful copy is a self-bound enduring layer. It survives cleanup, can be covered by a later copy layer, and restores its physical recipe on departure.

Copied entry choices are new choices linked to the exact copy acquisition. Prior choices remain dormant under later copied abilities and resume when their original layer resumes. Choices are installed before historical entry facts freeze.

Actual and funding worlds use the same flat blueprint, filter union, copy rows, origin allocation, provider timestamp order and successful-entry pipeline. Projected departure restores the original physical identity.
CR614.12 projected characteristics include the pending copy and its own type effects for creature-sensitive entry tap and counter replacements.
Mana-payment continuation enumerates copied entry choices, rejects unfundable actor choices transactionally and retains foreign choices/events when a parent cast fails.
